If variable length routine output data is used, this parameter contains the length in bytes of the dataOutVar parameter. dataOut_1 Fixed-length output data to provide in the routine control response ... ... dataOut_n Fixed-length output data to provide in the routine control response dataOutVar Variable-length output data to provide in the routine control response Parameters (out) ErrorCode If the operation Xxx_Start returns value E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall send a negative response with NRC code equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value.
